Vendors released patched OpenSSL versions after disclosure.
likely: Unpatched legacy systems could remain exposed years later.
possible: Some closed appliances lag on OpenSSL updates.
unknown: Inventory of remaining vulnerable endpoints on the public Internet for any one observer.
